instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Music rights and publishing company managing a catalog of 5,000 songs across 200 songwriters and composers. Handling royalty collection, sync licensing for TV/film/advertising, and copyright enforcement. Seeking to implement automated royalty tracking from streaming platforms and AI-assisted music similarity detection for infringement monitoring. The company has mature core business processes but struggles with the tension between running the existing operation efficiently and carving out resources for innovation. We have pockets of digital maturity in specific teams while other areas rely heavily on manual workflows and spreadsheets.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.
answers.additionalContext: We are planning an IPO within 24 months and need to demonstrate a track record of innovation-driven growth to public market investors. The CFO has asked for a 3-year innovation investment plan with clear KPIs that can be included in our equity story and analyst presentations. Bonus points for initiatives that improve our ESG metrics, as this is a key focus area for the listing venue.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 6 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: Implementing Advanced Digital Customer Self-Service Portals & Churn Prevention Tools
opportunities.rationale: The existing successful onboarding flow proves digital capability. This next phase must directly address the critical gap identified: poor self-service tools leading to high churn, particularly among mid-tier and enterprise clients. Scaling this effort is crucial for improving customer retention and maximizing lifetime value.

first_actions: Conduct comprehensive journey mapping focused exclusively on the 3 highest-churn pain points reported by exit interviews.
Incorporate compliance checkpoints (e.g., usage rights verification) into the portal's self-service features.
Prioritize feature development based on ROI calculation tied to specific segment retention uplift.
Develop integration APIs with existing billing/royalty management systems.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in voluntary customer churn rate by 10% within 12 months.
milestones: Minimum Viable Product (MVP) of self-service portal released for beta testing (Q4)
Achievement of a 95% completion rate for routine customer tasks via the digital channel.

opportunities.title: Developing an Automated, Predictive Royalty & Rights Management System (AI-Powered)
opportunities.rationale: Moving beyond manual tracking is essential for scalability and IPO readiness. This system must automate royalty collection from fragmented sources (streaming, sync) and use AI to proactively detect infringement patterns. This structural change significantly de-risks the core revenue stream and provides a measurable ESG/efficiency metric.

first_actions: Commission a technical feasibility study for deep integration of streaming platform APIs and third-party data sources.
Establish detailed compliance protocols regarding cross-border copyright enforcement using automated tools (legal review mandatory).
Define the scope and training data set required for AI music similarity detection models.
Pilot the system on a limited, low-risk segment of catalog rights to prove concept.
resources_needed: Legal Counsel specializing in global intellectual property law
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual royalty reconciliation time by 40% and measurable increase in automated infringement flagging.
milestones: Feasibility study approved and vendor selection initiated (Q3)
Pilot system deployment across a defined geographic region.

next_steps.action: Formally draft the 3-year innovation investment plan with clear KPIs and ownership for inclusion in IPO documentation.
Conduct a deep, quantitative journey mapping exercise focused on high-value mid-to-enterprise customer segments to define precise digital self-service requirements.
Establish a formal Project Management Office (PMO) function to govern the execution, resource allocation, and cross-functional dependencies between the innovation squad and core product teams.

key_weaknesses: Translating strategic urgency (IPO readiness) into day-to-day operational focus remains challenging.
Dependencies on manual workflows and spreadsheets persist, hindering true digital scalability across non-core teams.
Need for clearer governance model to transition the innovation squad's output into mandated core business product improvements.

improvements: Successful implementation of a cross-functional digital customer onboarding flow significantly improved NPS scores and reduced time-to-value.
Increased organizational structure stability through hiring senior leaders and formalizing strategic planning processes, moving away from pure founder dependency.
persistent_gaps: The underlying operational technology still lacks automation (manual workflows for royalty tracking remain a bottleneck).
Strategic alignment is needed between the ambitious 'IPO' goal and incremental process improvements required by core business units.
achieved_milestones: Successfully digitized customer onboarding, demonstrating cross-functional capability.
The innovation squad has demonstrated consistent quarterly progress reporting to the executive committee.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company shifted from a founder-led state to professional management with structured planning. Digital maturity increased significantly (from theoretical/low implementation to functional proof-of-concept), and the strategic focus has sharpened sharply due to the impending IPO goal.
